Baruipur rape-murder case: Key accused killed in police encounter

The main accused in the Baruipur rape and murder of a minor, Prabhas Mondal, has been killed in a police encounter. The incident occurred while police were reconstructing the crime scene. According to reports, the accused allegedly attempted to snatch a firearm and opened fire on the police team. The case had previously seen violence and mob activity after the minor's body was recovered.
